_doc: Thresholds for tools/check-bundle-shape.mjs (reads dist/<app>/stats.json, written by `ng build --stats-json`). Complements the angular.json budgets (size only) with chunk PLACEMENT.

Re-baseline DELIBERATELY, in the same change that legitimately grows or reshapes a bundle: (1) `npm run build -- --stats-json` and `npm run build -- la-app --stats-json`; (2) `npm run check:bundle-shape` and read the FAIL lines; (3) if the move is intended, set maxMainBytes / maxInitialBytes to about +3% over the new measured size (the guard prints kB = 1000 B) and update the initialFiles / lazyChunks expected values; (4) put the new numbers in the commit message. Never raise a ceiling to silence an UNEXPLAINED jump - the FAIL line names the module that moved.

maxInitialBytes covers main + every chunk main imports STATICALLY + polyfills + styles. forbiddenInInitial patterns are regexes over metafile input paths (forward slashes), checked in main and in the statically-imported chunks. A static import of a library barrel evaluates everything it re-exports, so projects/link-analysis/src/public-api.ts must stay light (see its header).

Measured 2026-10-02 (production): gamma main 1877959 B, eager (main + static chunks + polyfills + styles) 4888709 B in 29 files, 114 lazy JS chunks; la-app main 1980572 B, eager 3037577 B in 8 files, 15 lazy JS chunks. NB the Angular CLI report counts only main+polyfills+styles as initial (2.50 MB for gamma); the guard also counts the chunks main imports statically.
